sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Can be used to call in an airdrop when firing a red flare cartridge.
- Can be used to open flare extractions when firing a green flare cartridge.
- The pistol is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quest Rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a Quest Reward from Cease Fire!
